description: This Java class defines a model for a predefined shelf in a book tracking application. It extends a base Shelf class and includes properties such as predefined shelf name, associated books, and methods for equality and string representation. It also contains an inner enum for predefined shelf names.

classes.name: PredefinedShelf
classes.description: A predefined shelf that is created by the app and cannot be deleted or renamed. It extends Shelf and includes predefined shelf names and associated books.

classes.name: PredefinedShelf.ShelfName
classes.description: Enum representing the predefined shelf names: To read, Reading, Read, Did not finish.

methods.name: PredefinedShelf
methods.description: Constructor initializing the predefined shelf with a specific name and user.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the predefined shelf name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the predefined shelf name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the predefined shelf name.
